provenance.construction: Coset lifted product (CLP) code, Definition III.1 of arXiv:2610.12782, 1x1 over 2x2 layout, check weight 6. G = SmallGroup(648,720) (GAP SmallGroups id), H = <f5*f6*f7> = C3 given by generators in the polycyclic generating sequence f1,f2,... of G, m = [G:H] = 216, n = 4m = 864. Protograph a over F_2[G] acts by the left coset action on G/H, protograph B over F_2[N_G(H)] by the right coset action. a = 1 + f1*f3*f4*f5*f6*f7 + f1*f2*f3^2*f5*f7;  B = [[1, 1 + f1*f3^2*f4*f5^2*f7], [1 + f1*f3^2*f4*f5*f7, f1*f3^2*f4*f5^2]]. Rebuild with gap/rebuild.g in https://github.com/rajendrarajpurohit/CLP_QLDPC.
provenance.notes: New parameter set, not in arXiv:2610.12782. Found by the paper's search procedure extended from m <= 100 to 120 <= m <= 250 (pairs (G,H) with H cyclic, core free, [G:N_G(H)] in {2,3,4}), weight 6 shape |a| = 3 with B entry weights 2 1 / 1 2 or 1 2 / 2 1. Screened with QDistRnd, 10^6 rounds per side; the witness here is from this tool's own RIS search. Authors Rajendra Rajpurohit, V. Lalitha, Shayan Srinivasa Garani. The CI gate of PR #4477 found a weight 36 logical (orbit-fold search); the claim was lowered from 40 to 36 and that witness is the one carried on that side.
